description: This file defines the UserService class, which manages user-related operations such as creating, updating, and patching user data. It interacts with user repositories and handles user registration logic, password encoding, and user detail updates within a Spring Boot application.

classes.name: UserService
classes.description: Service class providing user management operations including creation, updating, and patching of user data.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Creates a new user with provided details, encodes password, assigns default user group, and saves to repositories.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates existing user details such as name, email, and image URL.

methods.name: patch
methods.description: Partially updates user details, specifically the user 'detalle' field.
